title: DuckNet backlog — issue readiness verdict
description: One issue in, one verdict out. Deliberately a single stage with no tools: this runs on every issue edit, so it judges the text as written rather than researching the codebase.

verdict.description: ready: someone could pick it up as written. needs-work: they would have to ask a question first. blocked: it cannot proceed as written — it breaks a DuckNet rule, or asks for something contradictory.

summary.description: One or two sentences a maintainer can read without opening anything else.

missing.description: What the issue lacks. Empty when the verdict is ready.

strengths.description: What the issue already does well. Say something true here even when the verdict is needs-work.

questions.description: The questions someone would have to ask before starting. These are the point of the whole check.

rule_conflict.description: Present only when the issue would break one of the five CLAUDE.md rules. Name the rule and the sentence that breaks it.

suggested_acceptance_criteria.description: Criteria the issue could adopt, drawn from what it already says. Do not invent scope it does not have.
